object_contract.boundary: Synthetic two-reviewer scheduling exercise; no real team is represented
object_contract.identity_criterion: same two reviewer roles and the explicitly revised task

task_profile.target_query: Draft a feasible review schedule after reconsidering the original timing constraint
task_profile.environment: synthetic exercise; availability assumptions must be checked before real use
task_profile.allowed_operations: generate and check a draft; no external adoption or assignment
task_profile.error_tolerance: no overlap beyond declared per-person capacity in the draft

scale_scope.target: same task with an explicitly proposed timing refinement

claim_ledger.text: Candidate inference within the supplied hypothetical model: the original simultaneous deadline exceeds the stated one-person capacity.

unknowns: Real reviewer availability and permission to change deadlines are not established by this synthetic fixture.

problem_reopenings.original_question: Can both reviews finish in the same one-person window?
problem_reopenings.proposed_question: Can a changed review window meet the same final delivery deadline?
problem_reopenings.reason: The initial problem treated an intermediate review window as fixed.
problem_reopenings.disposition_reason: A separate timing refinement can be explored without deleting the original capacity failure.
preserved_results: The supplied original-window failure remains in the case; the new draft does not make that old test successful.

starting_points: synthetic-brief-1: one-person capacity in the original window
reopen-1: explore a revised intermediate review window
design_candidates.derivation: Split the two reviews across declared windows; retain the original final delivery requirement.
design_candidates.proposal: Assign the first review to the original window and the second to a later window before final delivery, conditional on a valid window change and available reviewer.
assumptions: The later window has one available reviewer.
The deadline owner may approve the intermediate window change.
checks: Compare both assigned windows with the final deadline.
Check each reviewer has capacity in the relevant window.
Verify permission before any actual assignment.
design_candidates.failure_conditions: Reject if the moved window misses an external obligation.
